finding.claim: The missing-kmctl hint tells the user to run `kmctl plugin install`, a verb this release does not have (it lands in plugin-install-verb). This breaks the rule skills-name-only-shipped-verbs in .claude/rules/cli-version-floor.md, and a user who follows the hint gets "No such command".

fixes.change: The missing-kmctl hint no longer names kmctl plugin install, which does not exist yet, and the hook has a 10 second timeout so a hung briefing cannot hold up session start.
